Sulfur (S), oxygen (O2), water (H2O), and sodium chloride (NaCl) are all examples of pure
substances. Which of the following describes all pure substances?

options.A: A pure substance consists of only one type of element.
options.B: A pure substance has a definite chemical composition.
options.C: A pure substance cannot be broken down into simpler substances.
options.D: A pure substance is normally found as a solid at room temperature.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - A pure substance has a definite chemical composition.

questions.stem_text:
The speed of a sound wave varies as it travels through different substances. Which factor
will most affect the speed of a sound wave?

options.C: the source that created the sound
options.D: the distance between molecules in the medium

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the distance between molecules in the medium

questions.stem_text:
A lizard species mostly eats fruit from one particular type of tree. If a virus kills most
these trees, which individual lizards will most likely survive?

options.A: lizards that can climb higher in the fruit trees
options.C: lizards that can find other types of food

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - lizards that can find other types of food
